purpose: Teach: 蛇足/悪し/男前/わが子/惨め/見分ける/読み取る/老若男女

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに余計な蛇足を言うのは控えようね
lines.en: Sho, let's not say anything extra to Dad, okay?
lines.style: Gentle correction. Warm but clear boundary. Low volume, straightforward — not scolding, just steering. A mother's quiet way of teaching without making it hurt.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが「これは悪し方じゃない」と仰ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me this wasn't bad.
lines.style: Earnest, matter-of-fact. Small voice reporting something important to him. Not bragging — just sharing what he heard. A child's careful precision.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは本当に男前ね
lines.en: Sho, Dad really is dependable, isn't he?
lines.style: Soft warmth with a note of relief. Saying it half to herself, half to Sho. The tenderness of recognizing someone you love is trying. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがわが子のために頑張ってらっしゃるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad is working hard for us.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Not performing — observing. A six-year-old who has noticed something true and is offering it back to his mother. Gentle, steady.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ふざけて惨めな思いをさせないようにね
lines.en: Sho, let's not make fun in a way that would hurt him, okay?
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. A mother's care wrapped in a clear boundary. Low, steady tone. The kind of thing she says because she's protecting both of them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの本気と冗談を見分けるの上手だよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm good at telling when Dad is serious and when he's joking.
lines.style: Bright with quiet confidence. A child who has figured something out and wants to show her he understands. Eager to prove himself capable. Small lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの心を読み取るのは大事よ
lines.en: Sho, it's important to understand what Dad is really feeling.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. Not lecturing — offering wisdom quietly. The weight of a mother who knows her son is the kind of child who listens. Warm underneath the direction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祭りで老若男女が楽しんでたよ
lines.en: Mom, at the festival everyone was having fun together.
lines.style: Animated and present, the joy of a memory just relived. Eager to share what he saw. The openness of a child who wants his mother to know what made him happy. Slight breathless excitement.
